name: video-trimmer
description: AI-Powered Smart Video Trimmer and rough-cut engine. Features Gemini 3.8 Flash Multimodal Video Understanding (native video, Last-Take-Wins with Composite Pick-Up Backfill), Dual-Engine Word-Level Acoustic Ground Truth (Google Cloud STT V2 Chirp 3 default; Whisper optional), acoustic onset snapping, 20ms equal-power audio micro-crossfades, and multi-format NLE export (Premiere Pro XML, DaVinci Resolve XML, Final Cut Pro FCPXML).
